outcome: Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) diagnosis accuracy (sensitivity, specificity, positive predictive value, negative predictive value, overall diagnostic accuracy)
Neonatal outcomes (implied, but not detailed in results)
cohort: The study included 150 pregnant women identified as being at risk for Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) disorders.
finding: The Placenta Accreta Index (PAI) demonstrated high diagnostic accuracy for PAS, with 100% sensitivity, 97.3% specificity, and 97.3% overall accuracy, making it a reliable tool for identifying high-risk women.
